default.session_policy: Preexisting ambient principal; neither modified nor reconstructed. All nondefault test actors are owned immutable roles with explicit policies below.

notes: Each execution-role policy is installed once before any use and never mutated. Each caller authority has a distinct immutable role and STS identity; no restrictive session policy, tags, source identity, external ID, or MFA was supplied. All resource payloads are synthetic. Task tokens are deterministic redaction placeholders tied across observations; AWS data keys are never requested directly.

Probe Python kernel was interrupted after activity-authority-wrong-context-history; resources and full prior requests recovered from saved fixture, no role policy mutations. Caller sessions re-assumed with the same explicit controls for continuation.
No local validation commands, formatters, builds, or test suites were run. The fixture itself is native live evidence. Two owned CMKs only; no external task integrations/log groups were used.

Caller-no-kms Standard starts with allowed execution role succeeded. Cold immutable execution-role GenerateDataKey or Decrypt denies caused immediate KmsAccessDeniedException. An execution role restricted by kms:ViaService likewise failed; caller ViaService-restricted retained reads succeeded.

Activity execution-role GenerateDataKey denial and wrong machine-ARN encryption context both accepted StartExecution then failed with States.Runtime and native KMS cause. Activity Decrypt-denied execution role still scheduled work; Activity-authorized worker delivered and completed both tasks. This is observed behavior, not a universal claim that execution-role Activity Decrypt is unnecessary.

Cold sync Express caller Decrypt denial failed unless includedData=METADATA_ONLY. Fresh sync Pass/Wait with execution-role kms:* denied and caller allowed succeeded. Earlier warmed-machine requests also succeeded with denied caller. These samples bound cache behavior and do not establish exact reuse, eviction, principal-keying, or timing guarantees.

GetExecutionHistory includeExecutionData=false still required caller KMS Decrypt; DescribeExecution METADATA_ONLY did not. Allowed retained data reads failed on disabled key; denied caller retained AccessDenied precedence. Included-data histories and metadata snapshots are retained.

Warm Standard start immediately after DisableKey returned success but later failed States.Runtime. Cold disabled start and repeat after configured 60-second reuse failed immediately. Existing 85-second Wait execution also failed after key disable; full histories were read after reenable.

Workers required Activity-key Decrypt, not machine-key Decrypt. Heartbeat, success, and failure callbacks required no caller KMS. After machine key disable and >60-second reuse bound, success and populated failure callbacks failed KmsInvalidStateException with kmsKeyState DISABLED, heartbeat and omitted error/cause failure succeeded. After machine reenable, callbacks succeeded even while Activity key disabled; Activity delivery failed until Activity reenable.

CLI rejects explicit null strings before native transport. One raw SigV4 signed request with error=null and cause=null was then captured against an owned token while machine key disabled; it succeeded. Omitted fields were separately proven after the >60-second reuse bound. Raw signing is only this shape-validation bypass; all other calls use scripts/aws/aws_cli.py.

Asynchronous Express successful admission is captured, but terminal outcomes are not observable through DescribeExecution/GetExecutionHistory without logs. Logging was intentionally not provisioned. Standard terminal statuses and histories are captured; no async Express completion claim is made.

CloudTrail lookup by bare key ID only returned CreateKey in this probe; ARN lookups provided cryptographic records. Events include native requestID, userIdentity, encryptionContext, invokedBy/userAgent when supplied. Pagination and capture timestamps establish bounds; absence of late events is unsettled.

Two verification sweeps were interrupted client-side; saved observations and explicit continuation record every completed native request. Final describe calls confirmed all 24 machines absent, all 10 Activities absent, all 13 roles absent, and both CMKs PendingDeletion. Final sampled retained-execution reads after machine disappearance returned ExecutionDoesNotExist, so pending-key KMS behavior was not reached.

cleanup.kms_note: Both owned CMKs scheduled for minimum seven-day deletion and independently described as PendingDeletion; physical deletion has not occurred.
cleanup.execution_note: All 18 admitted Standard executions independently confirmed terminal before machine deletion; no DeleteExecution API was invoked. After machine disappearance, sampled retained execution DescribeExecution and GetExecutionHistory both returned ExecutionDoesNotExist, including metadata/no-data modes. One admitted asynchronous Express Pass/1-second Wait execution has no inspectable terminal status without logs; its state machine was independently confirmed absent.
